text: Phase 2 complete. Structured rank-1 queries across all kernels and both routes; O(q^4) dense query eliminated; rdm(plan, pairs=) public; memory accounting includes the live query representation; idempotent session close; validation-memo retention documented with bytes probe; Gate 5 benchmark landed with committed results (q=100/1080 searchlights: selected-100 0.23s, fused 4.6s vs materialized 18.3s = 0.25 ratio, oracle 4.4e-16, <512MiB incl. comparison arm) + opt-in test + scale.yml. Full suite green. The audit's P0 regression (fused 3.9x slower, 54s at q=100) is now a 4x advantage.
